title.zh: 历史各向同性压力磁通 Picard 平衡

summary: Construct an exact-midplane pressure-flux state and iterate a dense Green-matrix cell-current update up to a caller-specified bound, returning the last state and explicit convergence status.

identity.relation: midplane radial pressure, vacuum flux and cell-current Green response to an isotropic pressure-driven flux state
identity.direction: R-Z grid, P(R), vacuum flux, Green matrix and Picard controls -> flux, cell currents, P(psi) representation and convergence diagnostics
identity.definition: Build P(psi) from an exact zero-Z midplane and its first exact zero-pressure boundary; at each bounded Picard step form relaxed cell currents from dP/dpsi, apply the dense current-to-flux Green matrix, add vacuum flux, evaluate a psi-edge-normalized L2 residual, and rebuild the pressure state on the updated flux.
identity.model: historical axisymmetric isotropic pressure-flux Picard closure
identity.geometry: uniform rectilinear cylindrical R-Z grid with one complete exact Z=0 row
identity.coordinates: [Z,R] arrays and C-order field-cell/field-point Green-matrix row and column order
identity.boundary: The first exact zero in the radial midplane pressure samples defines the pressure edge; the pressure spline extrapolates to zero outside its sampled flux interval.
assumptions: The caller supplies a physically appropriate vacuum psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad and a dense cell-current Green matrix in Wb/rad/A; the pressure derivative is taken with respect to the same psi coordinate.
The supplied radial pressure is nonnegative at sampled midplane radii and yields at least four strictly increasing flux samples up to its first exact zero.
plasma_mask=True suppresses the pressure derivative in that cell; it does not mark an included plasma region.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.description: Cylindrical radius at each field cell.
inputs.constraints: Uniform strictly increasing R axis, rectilinear grid, at least two points per axis; same shape as z_grid and psi_vac.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.description: Axial coordinate at each field cell.
inputs.constraints: Uniform strictly increasing Z axis; exactly one complete row must equal Z=0 exactly.

inputs.name: pressure_of_radius
inputs.description: Midplane radial pressure function called at sampled R values.
inputs.constraints: Returns finite nonnegative scalar values; one sampled value must be exactly zero and the preceding flux samples must support a cubic spline.

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.description: Caller-supplied vacuum or external psi=R A_phi, copied into the initial state.
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the grids and aligned with Green-matrix field-point rows in C order.

inputs.name: g_psi
inputs.description: Dense response from cell currents to field-point psi=R A_phi.
inputs.constraints: Rows and columns follow [Z,R] C-order field points and current cells; not a coil-to-probe cache.

inputs.name: tol
inputs.description: Stopping threshold for the relative flux residual.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive; the initial residual sentinel is 1.0.

inputs.name: maxiter
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative; zero skips the update but still constructs and validates the initial pressure state.

inputs.name: relax
inputs.description: Weight of the previous cell current in the current update.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= relax <= 1; zero uses only the current pressure derivative.

inputs.name: plasma_mask
inputs.description: Cells whose pressure derivative is set to zero before current assembly.
inputs.constraints: If supplied, same shape as the grids; True suppresses the local derivative.

outputs.name: psi
outputs.description: Final psi=R A_phi, or an independent copy of psi_vac when no step runs.
outputs.constraints: Last evaluated flux state; no guarantee of convergence.

outputs.name: plasma_currents
outputs.description: Last cell-current state, zero before the first update.
outputs.constraints: One value per grid cell in [Z,R] order.

outputs.name: pressure_of_psi
outputs.description: Final pressure-flux samples and cubic-spline representation.
outputs.dtype: mapping of arrays, integer degree and strings
outputs.constraints: Includes psi_samples, pressure_samples, knots, coefficients, degree and zero-extrapolation metadata.

outputs.name: residual
outputs.description: Last normalized L2 flux-change residual, initially 1.0.
outputs.constraints: A nonfinite result marks failure; the step normalizes by abs(psi_edge).

outputs.name: residual_history
outputs.constraints: Empty when no step runs; excludes the initial sentinel.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: Whether the final residual is finite and at most tol.
outputs.constraints: Can be true with zero iterations when tol >= 1.0.

outputs.name: failure_reason
outputs.description: Explicit failure marker or null on convergence.
outputs.constraints: maxiter_reached for finite nonconvergence; nonfinite_source_residual for a nonfinite residual.

preconditions: All arrays and controls satisfy the declared shapes and finite-value constraints.
The exact midplane pressure profile and flux samples meet the pressure-state Operator's spline conditions.
A nonzero psi_edge is required when at least one Picard step runs.
supported: Bounded historical isotropic pressure-driven flux iteration on a declared uniform R-Z grid.
excluded: Nonuniform or unstructured grids and non-axisymmetric geometry.
Guarantees that a finite iteration bound will converge or that the caller's pressure and Green matrix are physically suitable.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for missing required controls, invalid shapes or grids, nonfinite supplied arrays, invalid pressure samples, mask mismatch, or invalid Picard controls; bound Operator failures propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency or pressure callback failures propagate without fallback. A nonfinite computed residual is returned as an explicit failed result if the dependency returns it.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Returns the final state with converged=false and failure_reason=maxiter_reached when the finite residual remains above tol at maxiter; nonfinite residual uses nonfinite_source_residual.
failure_semantics.partial_results: A bounded nonconverged result includes last flux, currents, pressure representation and residual history; exceptions return no mapping.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel composition mapped to saved Pleiades L1 pressure-flux TaskGraph and direct graph tests; historical review labels are development provenance, not expert recognition of this version.
source_kinds: saved L1 TaskGraph contract and implementation

example.description: With a zero Green response, one update leaves the vacuum flux unchanged while constructing a pressure spline.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.equilibrium import solve_isotropic_pressure_flux
r_grid, z_grid = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, 4), [-0.1, 0.0, 0.1])
result = solve_isotropic_pressure_flux(r_grid=r_grid, z_grid=z_grid, pressure_of_radius=lambda r: max(1.0-r/0.8, 0.0), psi_vac=r_grid.copy(), g_psi=np.zeros((12, 12)), tol=1e-12, maxiter=1, relax=0.0)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['psi'], r_grid)
assert result['iterations'] == 1 and result['converged']
assert result['pressure_of_psi']['extrapolation'] == 'zeros'
example.expected: One converged update, unchanged vacuum flux, a [3,4] current array and a zero-extrapolating pressure-spline representation.

scope: A one-cell current generated by the real graph produces the selected off-source circular-filament psi=R A_phi increment without a 2*pi factor.
Wrong Green shape, missing controls, nonuniform grid and fractional maxiter failures.
Zero-iteration return owns an independent flux array.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct graph and Operator regressions establish selected arithmetic, state order, failure paths and one finite circular-filament flux projection for the historical isotropic model. They do not prove source parity, convergence or physical suitability for arbitrary pressure functions and Green matrices, nor confer expert recognition.
known_limitations: Uses a dense square Green matrix and a pressure spline defined by an exact midplane and exact zero-pressure sample.
No adaptive damping or physical-model selection is performed.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.

nodes.description: Copy vacuum flux and initialize previous currents to null and residual to 1.0.
Build the exact-midplane P(psi) spline, masked derivative and edge flux on the current psi.
Compute relaxed cell currents, dense Green flux and a normalized flux residual.
Apply tol/maxiter stopping and return the last available state, pressure representation and explicit diagnostics.

execution.ordering: Validate all graph controls and geometry, construct initial pressure state, then while residual > tol and iterations < maxiter run the step, rebuild pressure state, append residual and increment iterations; return the last state.
branches: maxiter=0 or initial residual 1.0 <= tol: skip all Picard updates but return the initial pressure representation.
A finite residual above tol at the bound returns maxiter_reached; a nonfinite residual returns nonfinite_source_residual.
execution.state_ownership: The graph owns copies of evolving psi, currents, residual history and count; the caller owns the input grids, vacuum flux, pressure callable and Green matrix.
execution.failure_propagation: Invalid input or a dependency exception aborts without a result; bounded nonconvergence is returned as explicit data, not raised.

feedback.state: psi, old cell currents, pressure derivative, edge flux, residual and iteration count
feedback.initialization: psi is a copy of psi_vac; old currents are None, residual is 1.0, count is zero, and the initial pressure state is built before the loop.
feedback.update_order: Step from current pressure state and old currents; assign psi_next and currents; rebuild P(psi) on psi_next; append residual and increment count.
feedback.stop_when: Residual <= tol, the iteration bound is reached, or a NaN residual makes the comparison false; an infinite residual continues until the bound.
feedback.nonconvergence: Return the final state with converged=false and maxiter_reached for finite residual, or nonfinite_source_residual for nonfinite residual.
